::: {#exm-rule-of-inference}
#### Modus ponens

Argument 1 of @exr-valid-arguments follows the pattern
$$
\frac{P \Rightarrow Q, \quad P}{Q},
$$
called modus ponens.
It is a rule of inference (@def-rule-of-inference):
by @sol-valid-arguments, its premises entail its conclusion
for any propositions $P$ and $Q$, not only for tests and builds.

:::
